verdict.rationale: Chroma's docs confirm that `.query` supports metadata filtering, combined with `where_document` full-text and regex search, so filtered vector search is a first-party capability. Nothing in the pack covers the structured metadata operators available, or whether filtering keeps recall and latency intact. missing for 10: documented metadata filter operators and conditions, evidence on filtered-search recall, latency or benchmark behavior, independent or hands-on corroboration

support.subject: As a developer, I can filter vector search by structured metadata conditions without wrecking recall or latency

citations.quote: `.get` and `.query` can handle `where_document` search combined with metadata filtering
You can query the collection with a list of query texts, and Chroma will return the n most similar results.
